parameters.name: FlowID
parameters.description: The flow ID used to identify a flow in the network. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfFlowID'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}. Note that the data type has changed from ''unsignedInt'' to ''MACAddress''. This is because the original data type was an error and could not have been implemented as specified.

parameters.name: PacketDA
parameters.description: The Destination Address (DA) for the packets in this flow. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfPacketDA'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: MaxRate
parameters.description: Maximum required rate in {{units}}. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfPeakDataRate'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: MaxBurstSize
parameters.description: Maximum burst size. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfBurstSize'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: LeaseTime
parameters.description: Flow lease time (expressed in {{units}}). A {{param}} of 0 means unlimited lease time. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfLeaseTime'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The FLOW_TAG of the PQoS flow identified by {{param|FlowID}} in which this MoCA interface is an Ingress Node for this PQoS flow. The FLOW_TAG carries application specific content of this PQoS flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|Section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: LeaseTimeLeft
parameters.description: Flow lease time remaining (expressed in {{units}}). If {{param|LeaseTime}} is 0 then a {{param}} of 0 means unlimited lease time; otherwise, a {{param}} of 0 means expired. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfLeaseTimeLeft'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: FlowPackets
parameters.description: The number of packets transmitted for this flow. This parameter is based on ''mocaIfTxPacketsFlow'' from {{bibref|MOCA11-MIB}}.

parameters.name: IngressGuid
parameters.description: The MAC address of the MoCA Node specified by the INGRESS_NODE_ID parameter of the flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|Section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: EgressGuid
parameters.description: The MAC address of the MoCA Node specified by the EGRESS_NODE_ID parameter of the flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: MaximumLatency
parameters.description: The MAXIMUM_LATENCY parameter of the flow in units of milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates no value available. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: ShortTermAvgRatio
parameters.description: The SHORT_TERM_AVERAGE_RATIO parameter of the flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: FlowPer
parameters.description: The FLOW_PER parameter of this flow, where a value of 0 indicates NPER and 1 indicates VLPER. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: IngressClassify
parameters.description: The INGRESS_CLASSIFICATION_RULE parameter of the flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: VlanTag
parameters.description: The VLAN_TAG parameter of the flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: DscpMoca
parameters.description: The DSCP_MOCA parameter of the flow. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 6.3.13.1}}.

parameters.name: Dfid
parameters.description: The destination flow ID of the flow assigned by the Ingress Node. See {{bibref|MoCAv2.0|section 7.8.1.2}}.

object.description: The flow statistics table provides information on the MoCA parameterized QoS flows this interface has allocated onto the MoCA network.
